"""KinDER i00 robot client control script. Only documented sensors and actions."""
import json, pathlib, sys
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=pathlib.Path('/app/output')
r=Robot()
def observe(tag='obs'):
    res=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none')
    res.save(str(OUT/tag))
    print(json.dumps(res.meta))
    return res
if __name__=='__main__':
    (OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(r.spec(),indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(r.spec(),indent=2))
    observe('initial')
PY
